evidence: Replaces hardcoded headers presync parameters with runtime continuous relaxation search in src/headerssync.cpp and src/net_processing.cpp.
rationale: Dynamically derives headers presync DoS-protection parameters at node startup, correcting an attack model flaw where attackers abort mid-batch. Adapting parameters automatically based on chain age and minchainwork height removes a recurring maintainer estimation burden and prevents degraded DoS protection over time.
